notes: No body (request.get_json(silent=True) tolerates missing/invalid JSON): logs today. Returns full updated goal row plus already_completed_today, already_logged (false on first log of the day) and logged_date. Volatile values normalized: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' timestamps -> <TS>, bare 'YYYY-MM-DD' dates -> <DATE>. Autoincrement ids kept as recorded (first rows of a fresh database).
